title: When people ask me what I do. I don't say poet. Ask me what I am. I might say maybe. It's how I remix me. #poetryport
summary: When people ask me what I do. I don't say poet. Ask me what I am. I might say maybe. It's how I remix me. #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
When people ask me what I do.
I don't say poet.
Ask me what I am.
I might say maybe.
It's how I remix me.
#poetryport
